summary.text: Stephanie Dietz is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 65 since 2023 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as Stephanie A. Dietz, a lawyer.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Dietz, listed by Ballotpedia as Stephanie A. Dietz, graduated from Woodford County High School in 1987.
She earned a B.S. in political science from the University of Kentucky and a J.D. from Northern Kentucky University in 1994.
Her career experience includes owning Dietz Family Law PLLC and working as a partner and lawyer with O'Hara, Ruberg, Taylor, Sloan, & Sergent Attorneys at Law.
Dietz assumed office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Charles Wheatley (D).
In the 2025-2026 session she served on the House Appropriations and Revenue, Families and Children, House Judiciary, and Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations committees.
